clips.send: A friend sends this to someone stuck in negative self-talk - curiosity at the weird chicken video, then the punch that your own mind needs the same training.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau once paused his own show to prove a point: a guy trained chickens, in just a couple of days, to jump, spin on command and even try to fly.

His point wasn't about the chickens. Train an animal that small this precisely, and you can train something far more powerful — your own mind.

Most people let their thoughts run the show: the chatter, the self-sabotage, the doubt that talks them out of everything before they start.

Kevin says quieting that chatterbox is the first real step to success. Your mind should work for you, not the other way around.

What's one thought you need to retrain today?
